items.line: London derby at Stamford Bridge. Chelsea beat Everton 2-0 and Bournemouth 5-1 after a 3-0 loss at Brentford; Spurs drew 1-1 at Man Utd and beat Coventry 3-1.
Katie Boulter reached the quarter-finals in Osaka; Rybakina is in the Ningbo Open quarter-finals. Finals come this weekend.
